(R) T542: the original was started from the Jobs window (147/1 row, then 49/15 with original quest id 1964); the giver is the trainer Flitter (9000000091), the single talk target is the same trainer, and the turn-in is the giver, so one Talk to the trainer completes the step and opens the end screen there. Reward: 5 coins (the W110 fallback for an unknown payout) and no job XP, so a locked profile can never block the turn-in. No intro, prerequisite or job gate is bound; because the giver is the trainer, the trainer's own menu also offers it.

(R) T542: the client description 412446 names Felipe (9000000086), a poi_anchor row the 35/2 draw set omits; the job_trainers.json profile 4 trainer is Flitter (9000000091), T407's reachable Sanctuary postmaster, so giver, target and turn-in are Flitter.
